title: Your friend group as a hand of cards
caption:
Every friend group is a hand of cards. Who's who in yours?

The one who books everything. The one who suggests the trip at 1am and will not be booking it. The one everyone calls at midnight. The one who's quiet until there's a flat tyre.

Send this to the group chat and assign everyone a card. Then make them take the test to settle it.
